> Test whether it happens on other sites and on a different network.

If every site resets, the cause is local: a VPN, a proxy, antivirus TLS inspection, or a network adapter. If only one site resets and it does so from several networks, the cause is that server. If small pages load and large ones fail, you have an MTU problem in the path, which you can confirm with a ping using the do-not-fragment flag.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/err-connection-reset/
